latest.title: Advanced airway not linked to traumatic arrest survival
latest.finding: Thirty-day survival 1.8% with advanced airway vs 1.4% matched controls (corrected RD 0.6%, 95% CI −0.1 to 1.2); favourable neurological outcome 0.2% vs 0.4% (corrected RD −0.2%, 95% CI −0.6 to 0.1) — no significant timing-dependent association

latest.title: Paramedics miss many non-convulsive seizures
latest.finding: Sensitivity 54.0–58.5% and specificity 95.9–96.6% against variable reference standards; recognition rates 56.8–89.7%; non-convulsive seizures missed in 53.0–81.4% of cases

latest.title: Sepsis suspicion at dispatch, earlier antibiotics
latest.finding: Dispatch suspicion of sepsis was associated with a 31-minute shorter adjusted time to antibiotics (95% CI −59.9 to −1.8 min)

latest.title: Frequent Callers to Emergency Medical Services
latest.finding: Frequent callers (5+ calls in 12 months) were 3.0% of callers but 19.9% of calls; alcohol/intoxication/overdose and suicidal presentations were top contact causes only in the highest-volume post-threshold groups
